lines: Okay China, give me back my charger.
Your charger? I made your charger.
You paid me. So it is mine twice.
That is not how money works!
It is how MY money works.
Alright. You know what? Then it is WAR!
Okay. Wait. Let me explain how we got here.
Seven days ago, the United Nations closed. Forever. No more rules.
Conquer a country, and its army is yours. And everybody heard that.
Wait, so... is invading allowed now?
Yes! That was the whole point of the rules!
I HAVE BEEN READY SINCE NINETEEN FIFTY-THREE!
Oh no. Oh no no no.
Hey Guyana. Nice oil you have there.
Yes. It is literally on my map.
Nobody answered. Guyana lasted forty minutes.
San Marino! My little friend! Come here!
Why are you opening your arms like that?
It is dangerous now. Let me protect you.
No, no. It is a hug. A very, very big hug.
Italy hugged San Marino. And Malta. Nobody knows why Malta.
Hey gringo. Now that there are no rules...
Not now, Mexico. I am fighting China.
I just want to say one thing. Tacos are better than hamburgers.
That is a declaration of war!
Guys, guys. Poutine is better than both.
Chile, remember the last match? Three to zero.
We won two Copa Americas against you!
And how many World Cups do you have?
You know what? Give me back Patagonia!
Relax, guys. It is carnival. Nobody fights during carnival.
While those two were shouting... Brazil quietly took Uruguay and Paraguay.
Belarus. You and me. One country again.
Belarus joined Russia without a single shot. Poland noticed.
I KNEW IT! I have been preparing for this since nineteen thirty-nine!
Calm down, Poland. Europe will act together.
Together, yes. Under my command, of course.
Under YOUR command? I pay for everything!
And I have nuclear weapons and good cheese.
Can we PLEASE focus? Russia is RIGHT THERE!
I shall be over here. On my island. Judging all of you.
Also, Monaco is very close to you. Just saying.
France took Monaco. Monaco did not even notice. They were on a yacht.
Turkey. Now that there are no rules... the coffee. It is GREEK coffee.
It is TURKISH coffee. It has been Turkish coffee for five hundred years!
Says the name of the coffee!
One more word and I send my navy.
Do not worry, I am not involved. These drones are just visiting.
The drones were not just visiting.
Saudi. Persia ruled this region for two thousand years.
And I have one thing you do not have. Money. A lot of money.
Guys, guys. I am small but very rich. Can I just pay you both?
You are small... and very close to me.
Iran crossed the Gulf. Kuwait. Bahrain. Qatar. In one night.
Pakistan, my friend! How much for your army?
For you? Special price. I also want snacks.
Then I am already on the plane.
Okay. Then I will take care of Bhutan for you.
It is not yours. And now it is mine.
India took Bhutan "for its own safety". Pakistan is still screaming about it.
Hey, Denmark. Sorry to bother you.
Oh, hi Canada! No problem. What is up?
So, um... I am taking Greenland. Sorry.
Before America does. Sorry. Really sorry.
Canada sent one boat to Greenland. It apologized forty-two times on the way.
That is the fourth one today.
But it was very scary, yes?
West Africa! Listen to me! Alone we fall!
Together we are two hundred and fifty million. And I am the boss.
Wait, when did we agree you are the boss?
Benin, Togo and Niger joined Nigeria. Mostly because Nigeria said so.
Ethiopia. That dam. Open it. NOW.
Or I come and open it myself!
Good luck. I just took Eritrea and Djibouti. I have a coast now!
Ethiopia finally got its coast back. Egypt is still staring at the river.
And all over the world... the small countries started to disappear.
Liechtenstein. Andorra. Luxembourg. Brunei. East Timor.
Laos and Cambodia went to Vietnam. Myanmar went to Thailand.
I will just stay very, very quiet down here.
Seventeen thousand islands. Nobody is invading me.
No worries, mates. We are very far away from all of this.
Australia was wrong. But that is a story for another episode.
Australia. The pavlova. It was invented in New Zealand.
Mate. It was invented in Australia. Everybody knows that.
Then explain why it is named after a dancer who visited ME first!
That is it! I am invading!
Japan, since North Korea keeps missing you... want to be friends?
Friends? After you said ramen is Korean?
It is literally the same word!
China. Old friend. What did America want?
Ha! And you gave it back?
I made a better one. Ten times cheaper.
Day seven. The radar screens in Taipei light up all at once.
Why are there two hundred ships outside my window?
America. If Taiwan falls, I am next. Decide. NOW.
I am deciding! I am deciding!
Your ships can use my ports. Just hurry!
The two biggest navies in history. Twenty kilometers apart.
Last chance, America. Turn your ships around.
Funny. I was about to say the same thing.
And give me back my charger.
Then we have nothing left to talk about.
Who wins the battle of the Pacific? Tell me in the comments.
